items.text: Bobo da iswamauni ewema kaigalisio atomon; nuka ebaputa loecipitai kiusio lueriim ka lobululu, ka lomuge, ka lokarenan, nepepe kikerubin aswam naka ekeswaman loepiriana ŋes iswamaunia kes.
Aojau naka ninigalisit korai ikubitin akaisaarei ka lukanykauni, alalau naka niniigalisit ikubitin iwonon: aigalisio kere koraas nuka aitemis adiopet.
Iropikini aigalisio akany; iropikini da aigalisio ace akany.
Iswamakini da akodeta nubululu oreret loka aigalisit nakawasia kotoma kanueropikinitai: iswamakini da kwaŋin oreret loka aigalisit nakawasia kotoma kanuce nueropikinitai.
Iswamakini akodeta akaisakany toma aigalisit adiopet, iswamakini da akodeta akaisakany oreret loka aigalisit nakiareit naeropikinitai; kiteosi da akedeta ijun.
Iswamauni aruceta akaisakany nuka esabu, imorikikini aigalisio nun karuceta kanun: koraun ediopewema.
Iswamauni aigalisio nuka aiulo nuka akinei araun ewema kokuiu owema: iswamauni aigalisio atomon ka nadiopet.
Aojau naka niniigalisit korai ikubitin akaisauni, alalau da naka niniigalisit korai ikubitin iwonon: aigalisio nun atomon ka nadiopet koraas kere nuka aitemis adiopet.
Iropikini aigalisio akany kowaikec bonik, ka aigalisio akanykape kowaikec, ikudokini aigalisit nakikanyetekape koinaren kewema.
Iswamauni akodcta akaisakany koreret loka aigalisit nakawasia kanun kanueropikinitai, ka akodeta akaisakany koreret loka aigalisit nakawasia kanuce kanueropikinitai.
Iswamauni aruceta akaisakany nuka aisinit, ibwaikini aruceta nun toma akodeta, imorikikini ewema nepepe, tetere eraun ediopet.
Ka atutubet nin naesalakini naekudokina naka aigalisio nuka ewema, atutubet nin naka aigalisit naesalakini ijeko kokau kewema.
Ekubit ediopet owai ediopet, ka ekubit cdiopet owai loce, loesali kaojau naka aigalisio nuka ewema ijeko kosiepion luka ewema, owai lo kowai je da, arapit.
Iswamauni eimukoret loka ewema kimukulen luka imerekekin Iuiterenitai, kokuiuke da eimukoret loka imukulen luka etakas.
Iswamauni abaoi nuka ewema nuka akito nuka sita, nuesipos.
Aoiau naka ninibao ikubitin itomon, alalau da naka ninibao ekubit ediopet ka atutubet.
Ejaun ninibao karucetake aarei, nuerucokinito adiopet mama ejai nace: iswamauni kwaŋin abaoi kere nuka ewema.
Iswamauni abaoi nuka ewema, abaoi akaisaarei kowai loka eŋalakimak kari naka eŋalakimak.
Iswamauni aigaŋeta akaisaoŋon nuka epuesa kwap kabaoi nun akaisaarei; aigaŋeta aarei kwap kabao adiopet neelomarete arucetake aarei ka aigaŋeta aarei kwap kabao ace neelomarete arucetake aarei,
Kowai lokiareit loka ewema kari naka agolitomei, abaoi akaisaarei;
Aigaŋetakec nuka epuesa akaisaoŋon; aigaŋeta aarei kwap kabao adiopet, ka aigaŋeta aarei kwap kabao nace.
Iswamauni da abaoi akanykape kowai lokokau loka ewema ari nakoto,
Iswamauni da abaoi aarei nuka agoria nuejaas to kewema.
Koraas aareiarei kokwap, kwaŋin irotakina abaoi nepcpe anyoun kokwap aitodol kuiu ogilut ediopet: ejaunete kwaŋin kere aarei; eraas nuka agoria nun aarei.
Ejaunete abaoi akanykauni, ka aigaŋetakec nuka epuesa, aigaŋeta atomon ka nukanykape; aigaŋeta aarei kwap kabao adiopet, ka aigaŋeta aarei kwap kabao nace.
Iswamauni ariino nuka akito nuka sita; ariino akany nuka abaoi nukowai ediopet loka ewema.
Ka ariino akany nuka abaoi nukowai lokiareit loka ewema, ka ariino akany nuka abaoi nukoto kewema, ari nakoto.
Ka ariit nakokidin naejai kidin kabaoi iriikini anyoun kepuai kiton epuai.
Iladaari abaoi nun ke sa bu, iswamauni da igilunukec lukitolomanakina ariino kesabu: iladaari ariino kesabu.
Isipokini ewema kaputoke naaponi kitcdikin jo komoru.
Ido iswamauni aigalisit kegoe kalobululu, ka lomuge, ka lokareijan, ka ebaputa loecipitai kiusio lueriim: icipakinio ikerubin ogoe aswam naka ekeswaman kaloepiriana:
Ikajakini opirin iwonon luka akito nuka sita luiladaaritai kesabu, eraunos igolunakec luka esabu, kotoma aigaŋeta aoŋon nuka epuesa.
Ikajakini aigalisit kwap kogolun, itolomikin asaduku naka aiteienunet toma aigalisit: etiaki aigalisit kamakus aibois nakalaunan ka aibois nakalaunan noi.
Ibwaikini eicolon-Iokaitim toma asaduku naka aiteicnunet aibois nakalaunan noi.
Ibwaikini emesa kina kaigalisit, ka epir loka atala kiteos kemesa kowai loka ewema ari naka eŋalakimak: ibwaikini cmesa ari naka agolitomei.
Ido iswamauni aigalisit naka ekek loka Ewema, lobululu, lomuge, ka lokarenan ka ebaputa Ioecipitai kiusio lueriim, aswam naka ekasonyan.
Ido iswamakini aigalisit ipirin ikany luka akito nuka sita, iladaari kes kesabu; eraunos igolunakec luka esabu: itataikini kes aigaŋeta akany nuka aisinit.
